explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1137: max_{n<x} d_n·d_{n-1} / (max_{n<x} d_n)² → 0, with d_n = primeGap n = p_{n+1} - p_n (0-indexed). The n = 0 term uses d_{0-1} = d_0 by ℕ subtraction, a harmless boundary artifact. Whether x bounds the index or the prime does not matter, because the ratio only changes at prime indices and the limit is the same. The open question is stated affirmatively.
